messages:
Alice Chen: quick heads-up, i'm taking primary for the next 8h (1952-10-xx). listing the access checks i'm doing before i hand off later today. please confirm your perms if you're on secondary or bridging.

Miguel Torres: noted. i'll be secondary for the first half. will verify access now.

Alice Chen: PD: i'm primary on the redwood-prod escalation policy. Miguel, do you have 'Admin' escalation rights on the PD service? run `pd whoami` or check the team page.

Miguel Torres: checked — i have 'Responder' on the service but not 'Admin'. pinging @Priya in case we need fast admin escalations.

Priya Nair: i can be emergency admin during overlap window. recommend we add Miguel to the Admin group now if we expect him to escalate.

Alice Chen: thanks. adding the quick checklist i'm doing:
- PagerDuty: verify escalation policy bindings, confirm contact methods (SMS + mobile push), check schedules.
- AWS: confirm cross-account role `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-oncall` is still active, MFA working, and session duration >1h.
- Grafana: confirm read permissions on `redwood-prod` dashboards and access to alerting history.

Samir Patel: grafana heads-up — the read token for the ops-group expired yesterday. i rotated it in vault but you might need to re-login once. link: https://grafana.redwood.io/d/redwood-prod/overview

Alice Chen: noted, Samir. do you have the vault path? i couldn't find it.

Samir Patel: vault path is `secret/data/oncall/grafana-read-token`. i posted the rotation PR in #eng-infra.

incident-bot: [INC-482] New: High 95th p90 latency on inference-router-prod. triggered at 1952347600. customer-impact: partial degradation for small subset of requests.

Alice Chen: i'm picking up INC-482 as primary triage. quick triage notes:
- Symptoms: increased p90, errors ~2% in a small shard, no total outage.
- First mitigation: route traffic away from the suspicious pool, enable fallback model variant.
- Runbook anchor: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/oncall/incidents#inc-482

Priya Nair: can you confirm you have permissions to change routing in the router service? that requires: `infra-router:UpdateTraffic` in AWS and grafana to validate the route change.

Alice Chen: i do. executing the redirect now. command: ```curl -X POST https://router-api.internal/v1/route -d '{"pool":"stable","weight":0.0}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN'```

Miguel Torres: got a heads-up from pagerduty-bot, it created an escalation. pagerduty-bot: `Escalation triggered for INC-482 -> Miguel Torres (secondary)`

pagerduty-bot: Action required: Miguel Torres, confirm you can access the incident detail page: https://pd.redwood.com/incidents/INC-482

Miguel Torres: i'm on the PD incident page. can see notes. i don't have admin actions but can add responders and acknowledge.

Priya Nair: if you need to run any infra commands, Miguel, you'll need the AWS cross-account role. try: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-oncall --role-session-name miguel-oncall`

Miguel Torres: assume-role succeeded, session valid for 1 hour. MFA prompt worked.

Alice Chen: good. after rerouting i see p90 drop starting. keeping an eye for 10m to confirm.

Samir Patel: also check Grafana alert history for related bursts — dashboard panels `router.latency` and `router.error_rate` are your friends. if you need a quick shared link use: https://grafana.redwood.io/d/redwood-prod/router?from=now-30m

Alice Chen: documenting customer impact: currently 'Partial degradation' affecting <5% of inference requests via eu-west pool. flagged for postmortem if regression reappears.

Priya Nair: small ops note for handoff: the Canary fallback policy is manual in the router console. we should consider automating if we see repeated incidents. filing a ticket: https://issues.redwood.io/RED-931

Miguel Torres: for the upcoming handoff at 20:00 UTC, here's my checklist to be ready:
- Confirm PD contact methods (done)
- Ensure AWS role + MFA (done)
- Grafana read + alerting playback access (Samir rotated token; i re-auth'd, good)
- Slack bridge permissions to start incident zoom/bridge (ops-bot should be able to create a bridge)

ops-bot: Bridge created: https://meet.redwood.com/bridges/1952345678, host: Alice Chen, cohosts: Miguel Torres, Priya Nair

Alice Chen: leaving detailed notes in the runbook under 'current shift' before i sign off: what i changed, commands run, observed metrics, and links to logs.

Priya Nair: one more permissions callout: if you need to modify PD escalation rules mid-incident we should only do that with 2 approvers (security policy). tagging @security on the ticket.

Miguel Torres: ack. i'll be ready to pick up primary if Alice needs to step out. if anyone sees missing perms, call me and i'll escalate to Priya.

Alice Chen: thanks team. leaving the handoff note: primary=Alice Chen until 20:00 UTC, secondary=Miguel Torres, emergency admin=Priya Nair. runbook pointer: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/oncall/handoff-access. final check: everyone confirm you can access PD, AWS role, and Grafana now. :thumbsup:

Miguel Torres: :thumbsup: all good from me.

Priya Nair: :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: :thumbsup:, added the vault ref in the runbook.

Alice Chen: signing off to secondary watch — i'll be reachable on pager. leaving incident in monitoring state (INC-482).

incident-bot: INC-482 status updated: monitoring -> stable at 1952351000.

Alice Chen: closing thread for handoff notes. adding action items: RED-931 ticket for automating fallback, ensure PD admin perms updated for Miguel before next rotation.

Miguel Torres: logged a follow-up to track PD perms: https://issues.redwood.io/RED-932"
